hypothesis: Explicit BTC forced-liquidation labels may recover a selective long opportunity absent from V58: forced short-liquidation buying may continue when post-burst price and public flow persist, while forced long-liquidation selling may produce a distinct exhaustion-reclaim long. These are competing causal mechanisms and neither edge is established.
decision: Accept the authenticated 0xArchive liquidation endpoint as a materially new, non-live research input and qualify only the frozen one-hour bundle for schema, provenance, and exact public-tape row parity. Permit bounded historical acquisition and the preregistered continuation-versus-exhaustion experiment below. Do not infer direction from the all-long-liquidation qualification episode, inspect forward outcomes outside the contract, change V58, or promote either branch without separate after-cost validation and an approval-ready change proposal.
falsifier: Reject the source if immutable hashes drift, cross-source field parity fails, label direction semantics are disproven, or vendor recall is materially incomplete. Reject a branch if its untouched after-cost primary horizon has a nonpositive block-bootstrap lower confidence bound, fewer than 100 independent burst episodes, unstable monthly sign, or more than 30% of gross profit from its largest episode. Update only with a new append-only revision after evidence is frozen.

evidence.role: bounded source qualification and independent public-tape parity
unchanged active V58 route and direction contract

experiment_contract.episode_definition: Cluster same-direction liquidation fills separated by no more than 2 seconds. At each episode end, use only labels, public trades, and L2 updates observable at or before that timestamp.
experiment_contract.burst_features: Compute exact liquidation notional over trailing 5-second and 15-second windows. Define a burst using the prior 30 calendar days only at the 95th and 99th empirical percentiles, with at least 3 distinct liquidation trade IDs. Percentiles update strictly out of sample.
experiment_contract.continuation_branch: After a liquidated-short burst, evaluate a long only when the midpoint is at or above episode VWAP and trailing 5-second public-trade notional imbalance is positive 10 seconds after episode end.
experiment_contract.exhaustion_branch: After a liquidated-long burst, evaluate a long only when the midpoint has reclaimed episode VWAP and trailing 5-second public-trade notional imbalance is positive 10 seconds after episode end.
experiment_contract.entry_model: Enter at the first independently observed executable ask after the 10-second decision timestamp; reject snapshots that predate the decision.
experiment_contract.outcomes: Report net executable returns at 30 seconds, 2 minutes, 5 minutes, and 15 minutes. The 5-minute horizon is primary; the others are diagnostic and cannot replace a failed primary endpoint.
experiment_contract.cost_model: Deduct contemporaneous taker fee, spread, depth-walk slippage at candidate notional, and funding when applicable. Also report a doubled-slippage stress.
experiment_contract.dependence_control: Collapse overlapping episodes into one position-equivalent observation and compute stationary block-bootstrap confidence intervals by UTC day. Report monthly and regime strata without selecting a branch from strata alone.
experiment_contract.data_quality_exclusions: Exclude windows touching any declared recorder gap from 60 seconds before entry through the full 15-minute outcome horizon, any missing or hash-invalid source partition, and any label lacking trade-ID parity.
experiment_contract.promotion_evidence_minimum: At least 100 independent qualifying episodes in untouched partitions, positive net primary-horizon point estimate and block-bootstrap lower bound, no materially negative validation month, doubled-slippage survival, and largest profitable episode contribution at or below 30% of gross profit.
experiment_contract.portfolio_test: Only after standalone survival, replay the candidate beside the unchanged eight-asset V58 roster with actual concurrency, exposure, and venue caps. Report incremental return, drawdown, turnover, correlation, rejected signals, and portfolio profit-factor delta.

limitations: The bounded qualification page proves row identity and pagination exhaustion, not vendor-wide liquidation-label recall.
The first qualified hour is directionally one-sided and cannot validate short-liquidation coverage.
Historical price data has been used elsewhere; the pseudo-holdout is weaker than the prospective holdout and must be labeled accordingly.
The 100-episode minimum may require a long historical acquisition and may falsify practical trade-frequency viability even if conditional returns are positive.
The experiment can reject both branches; it is not evidence that a BTC long should be added now.
This revision cannot pause, retune, route, size, enter, close, restart, or promote a live strategy or lifecycle.
